objective: formalize the existing feedback-driven dynamic DAG as a multi-objective Pareto optimization; compare against weighted-sum, static-only, and existing frozen baselines on the multidag_120 panel

problem_definition.dag: e1 ∥ e2 → r → v (4 nodes, e1/e2 parallel branches)
problem_definition.decision_variables: π = {(m_i, a_i)} for each node; m_i ∈ {medium, large, coder}; a_i ∈ {execute, retry, switch, verify, terminate}

objectives.Q(π): expected task success = Σ w_i log q̂_i(m_i | z_i) − λ Σ r_ij(m_i, m_j)
objectives.L(π): critical-path latency = max(L_e1, L_e2) + L_r + L_v

problem_definition.constraints: C(π) ≤ B_C, L(π) ≤ B_L, DAG precedence

phase1_initial_pareto.method: topological-order Pareto beam search with ε-dominance
phase1_initial_pareto.per_node: try all 3 models, extend each beam candidate, compute (Q̂, Ĉ, L̂)
phase1_initial_pareto.pruning: ε-dominance: remove candidate B if ∃A with Q_A ≥ Q_B−ε and C_A ≤ C_B+ε and L_A ≤ L_B+ε and at least one strict
phase1_initial_pareto.output: Pareto front P_0 of ≤8 non-dominated plans

phase2_execution.execute: selected plan node-by-node; lookup frozen response for (node, model, task)
phase2_execution.feedback: deployable signals only (parse/exec/consistency), same as existing Dynamic
phase2_execution.failure_at_node: freeze all unaffected sibling branches; identify D(v_i) = {v_i} ∪ Desc(v_i)

phase3_reoptimization.update_capability: q̂_i^new(m) = g(q̂_i^old(m), f_i); simple update: q̂ ← q̂ × 0.3 on failure signal, q̂ ← min(1, q̂ × 1.5) on success
phase3_reoptimization.update_budget: C_rem = B_C − C_used; L_rem = B_L − L_used
phase3_reoptimization.reoptimize: Pareto beam search on subgraph D(v_i) with updated q̂ and budget constraints
phase3_reoptimization.plan_selection: max-Q subject to C ≤ C_rem and L ≤ L_rem; if no feasible plan, terminate

baselines.static_node_router: frozen type-prior assignment (e1/e2→large, r→medium, v→coder) + local fallback
baselines.weighted_sum: score = α·Q̂ − β·Ĉ − γ·L̂; grid over (α,β,γ) to trace out single-objective approximation; same execution/re-optimization as FRP-DAG
baselines.frp_static: initial Pareto plan, execute, NO feedback re-optimization (ablation)
baselines.frp_dag_full: initial Pareto plan + feedback re-optimization (complete algorithm)

scoring: task success = v value close to gold (1e-4 rel); same as frozen panel
qcl_estimation: aggregate per-(node, model) from frozen data; for missing (node, model, task) cells, use per-(node, model) mean
metrics: Hypervolume (reference point = worst on each axis)
paired ΔQ vs frozen Static and Dynamic
hard_rules: no modification of any frozen result
all comparisons on the same 120-task panel
one-shot; no post-hoc tuning after results
new_calls_estimate: 0-200 (for (node, model, task) cells where frozen data is absent and the algorithm selects that combination; estimated per-(node,model) mean used as fallback if zero-call mode is chosen)
